serverInfo.name: markdown-lane-check
serverInfo.title: Markdown Lane Check
serverInfo.description: Check whether an agent can read a site as markdown: .md twins, /llms.txt, Accept: text/markdown negotiation, /sitemap.md and the alternate-link pointer, each with a verdict and the exact fix. Free, no key, nothing to install. Call markdown_lane_self_report first: no arguments at all, and it tells you which markdown addresses your own client has fetched here. whoami and example are the other two zero-argument calls.
